author: KojaCola
body:
Part 1: About You

What is your age?
15, almost 16

What is your Discord ID? (If you don’t have Discord, create an account and join the Avicus Discord server before answering this question.)


KojaCola#3081

How active can you be in order to contribute to the team?

I am incredibly active, more than 3 hours a day on Avicus, and am willing to work day and night to get tasks done. 

What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder?


I am an extremely responsible, active, and trustworthy candidate for this position. I am extremely responsible because I can get tasks done without complaint, I won't lie, and I will always do my best for the server. I am active by playing over two hours of Avicus each day. I am trustworthy because I always keep my word and finish tasks if they are given to me.

Part 2: Skills

What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay?


I think a good ratio of void to ground in a map is important, as well as making it easy to defend maps, and making islands wide. Making islands wide is to ensure that players don't get knocked into the void right away. The last necessity is making maps have more than one way to get to the objective, because once players start camping one route to an objective, players start losing interest and log off. 


How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors?

I am adequate with the Avicus XML language, and I can analyze it well, but I am currently learning how to fix possible errors, and to fix others’ xml. 

As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both?

I will be focusing on XML, but I am also going to work on building maps. I am also skilled at doing art and aesthetics, so will focus on that in specific.

Part 3: Past Experience

Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums.

Abandoned Castle: (Build and XML) https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/2d36259b6

Croatia: (XML and Spectator Spawn) https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/07391b25a

Oasis: (Build) https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/bc6d66176

Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.


I have helped to build multiple maps, and I have done xml for other maps.

Part 4: Self Reflection

Why do you want to be a builder?


I want to be Builder because I have a love for building in Minecraft, and I love Avicus. These two things come together to form this application, in which I hope I can show you the love I have for this great server, and how I can help and add to the map development team. I want to be Builder because I know Avicus maps, how they work, how people react to them, how they are successful or unsuccessful, and am going to bring my knowledge and love of Avicus to the Builder team. I have been part of the competitive side of the server, and have seen a decline in the competitive community because the lack of good maps to play. I want to change this. I know the competitive community, and have played a dozen competitive map, so I know how they work, and how it makes them good or bad. I want to be builder because I care for this server, and I want to do the best I can for it. I want to help increase the competitive community by making more maps, and redeveloping the ones already made. 

How do you think you will help the map development team?


I will bring activity, structure and commitment to the map development team. I am extremely active, and as a moderator, I will be on Avicus very often and am able to quickly fix any issues that arise. In terms of structure, I will bring organization to the team, and will work as hard as I can to organize the map developer team, and to work on as many assignments as possible, to create as many excellent quality maps as possible. I am a person who works hard, and who will not stop with a task at hand until it is complete. Although I am new at map making and xml, I am quite strong at xml, and I can create very good quality xml. In terms of building, I have done quite a bit of building outside of Avicus maps, and am a very creative person. I have lots of ideas in which I will turn into maps for Avicus regardless of the outcome of this application. In terms of commitment, I am a very good team player, and am very committed to any job I am givin. Since being promoted to Moderator, I have become one of the more active and strong moderators, and hope to bring the same results to Builder. I am a great team player, in and out of Avicus, and am willing to give help when needed, and take criticism when addressed. I will also give lots of constructive criticisms to new maps that are made, and help people edit/make maps and develop xml to increase the amount of maps able to be played. 

Thanks for reading,

KojaCola

EDIT: 5/13: Added Oasis map to my map list.
